annotation.title_clean: An Act Promoting the Development and Regulation of Artificial Intelligence in the Philippines (House Bill No. 9601)
annotation.title_en: An Act Promoting the Development and Regulation of Artificial Intelligence in the Philippines (House Bill No. 9601)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: House of Representatives of the Philippines (Rep. Steve Chiongbian Solon)
annotation.summary_en: Philippine House Bill 9601 proposes a comprehensive AI Development and Regulation Act creating an AI Development Authority (AIDA) to formulate a national AI strategy, license and register AI developers and deployers, set ethics, data protection and cybersecurity standards, handle complaints, and promote AI R&D and international cooperation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates the Artificial Intelligence Development Authority under the Office of the President with a multi-agency Board of Trustees
Requires licensing, certification and registration of AI developers and deployers
Mandates AI ethics standards, impact assessments, transparency and data protection per the Data Privacy Act
Establishes complaint mechanism and cybersecurity standards for AI systems
Promotes AI R&D funding, incentives, talent development and international cooperation; penalties follow existing laws
